places.name: Albertini
places.summary: Alberte's little-sister café and cave: natural wines, small plates, pizza and pasta, as happy to serve a cola as a €200 bottle.

places.name: Aywa
places.correctionSource: https://nonoresto.be/restaurant/aywa/ + Visit Gent register (Lammerstraat 12; geocoded with Nominatim)

places.name: Bakkerij Bernard
places.summary: Gentbrugge bakery-cum-brocante shop where Bernard Van Steenberge bakes sourdough from a starter over 90 years old in a wood-fired oven, plus speculaas and award-winning Gentse mastellen.

places.name: Bar Terroir
places.summary: Wine bar and delicatessen on the Groentenmarkt pairing small-estate wines with artisan cheeses and charcuterie; everything is also for sale.

places.name: Bistro Jeanne
places.correctionSource: https://www.bistrojeanne.be/ (address on own site; geocoded with Nominatim)

places.name: Bukuu
places.summary: Traditional Gazan dishes cooked 'the way our mother made them' near the Dampoort.

places.name: Catberry
places.summary: Fully plant-based patisserie and coffee bar baking its cakes, brownies, cupcakes and frangipane in-house, also serving breakfast, lunch and high tea.
places.openingHoursNote: Opening days differ between its own website, FAQ and OSM — check catberry.be before visiting.

places.name: Chef Q
places.summary: Mediterranean-coast mezze and grill restaurant near the Citadelpark.

places.name: Chubby Cheeks
places.summary: 'Bar à manger' pairing seasonal bistronomic plates (oysters are a staple) with a curated natural wine list; listed by Gault&Millau.

places.name: CoPain
places.summary: Cooperative bakery founded in 2016 under baker Adriaan Druwé, baking sourdough and long-fermented wheat, spelt and rye breads with flour from Molens Descamps, sold from its shop in the Lousbergmarkt covered market.

places.name: De Gentsche Koekedoos
places.summary: Small craft bakery of Patrick Dutilleul and Claudine Leupe, singled out by De Tijd's Sabato as makers of real freshly baked Gentse mastellen, sold on Fridays and Saturdays.
places.openingHoursNote: Hours differ between sources (OSM vs bakkerindebuurt.be) — check before visiting.

places.name: Edel Rot
places.summary: No-nonsense natural wine bar and bottle shop by the Belfry, also pouring wild-fermented beers and ciders, with good music and soirées hosted by winemakers.

places.name: Edmond
places.summary: All-day café-bar in the former The Cover on the Vrijdagmarkt: newspaper and coffee by day, dinner (mains up to €17.50) and late drinks at night.

places.name: Flordi
places.summary: Cooperative meeting place with a fully vegan eetcafé, makers' market and coworking, opened after a four-year run-up and crowdfunding.

places.name: Ikura
places.correctionSource: https://ikurasushi.be/ (new location Jan Breydelstraat 8; geocoded with Nominatim)

places.name: Nam Jai
places.websiteNote: namjai.be now serves an online-casino page (checked 20 Oct 2026) — link removed

places.name: Ombra
places.summary: Chef Bert and sommelier Caroline's wine bistro on the Kraanlei: a short seasonal menu built on pure products and a broad, natural-leaning wine list.

places.name: Speenghar Restaurant
places.summary: Afghan restaurant in the Brugse Poort with rice and grill dishes such as qabuli palaw, plus traditional floor seating.

places.name: Suffys
places.summary: Family bakery-patisserie of Kristof Suffys making bread, viennoiserie, patisserie and chocolates daily in its own workshops, with a second shop in Sint-Martens-Latem.

places.name: Tartelette
places.summary: Tartelette bar run by pastry chefs Lies Dhont and Maurits van Lookeren (ex-De Baere and Del Rey) serving seasonal sweet and savoury tartlets finished to order, to eat in or pre-order for takeaway.

places.name: Tokyo Sushi
places.statusNote: Closed for holidays from Monday 19 to Wednesday 21 October 2026; open again from Thursday 22 October.

places.name: Win
places.summary: Natural wine bar near the Gravensteen with brunch, a cellar, a bottle shop and a B&B upstairs; oysters at €1 on the first Sunday.
